streak.title: Streak
streak.rule: Most days in a row online

bigday.title: Big day
bigday.rule: Most time online in one day

lonewolf.title: Lone wolf
lonewolf.rule: Most time online with nobody else around

inseparable.title: Inseparable
inseparable.rule: The two players with the most time online together

ships.title: Ships in the night
ships.rule: Two regulars (≥3 h each) who are least often online at the same time: time together ÷ the smaller playtime (needs ≥3 regulars)

lemming.title: Lemming
lemming.rule: Most logins within 10 min after the same other player logged in (follower → leader)

firstlight.title: First light
firstlight.rule: Most days as the first to log in (days with ≥2 players)

lightsout.title: Lights out
lightsout.rule: Most days as the last to log off (days with ≥2 players)

revolving.title: Revolving door
revolving.rule: Most logins on a single day

sunk.title: Went down with the ship
sunk.rule: Most sessions ended by a server restart

immortal.title: Immortal
immortal.rule: Most playtime between two deaths (or since joining, or until now); an in-game day is 30 min

daredevil.title: Daredevil
daredevil.rule: Most deaths in a single session

dejavu.title: Déjà vu
dejavu.rule: Shortest time between two of their own deaths

fastdeath.title: Speedrun to Valhalla
fastdeath.rule: Shortest time from joining to the first death

ragequit.title: Ragequit
ragequit.rule: Most logouts within 4 min of dying

pact.title: Suicide pact
pact.rule: Most times two players died within 60 s of each other

jonah.title: Jonah
jonah.rule: Most raids that started within 10 min of them joining

survivor.title: Raid survivor
survivor.rule: Most raids witnessed without dying in the first 5 minutes

casualty.title: Raid casualty
casualty.rule: Most deaths within 5 minutes of a raid starting

raid_foresttrolls.title: Troll whisperer
raid_foresttrolls.rule: Online for the most “The ground is shaking” raids

raid_wolves.title: Dog walker
raid_wolves.rule: Online for the most “You are being hunted” raids

raid_surtlings.title: Sulfur sniffer
raid_surtlings.rule: Online for the most “There's a smell of sulfur in the air” raids

raid_skeletons.title: Bone collector
raid_skeletons.rule: Online for the most “Skeleton surprise” raids

raid_bats.title: Bat signal
raid_bats.rule: Online for the most “You stirred the cauldron” raids

slayer.title: Slayer
slayer.rule: Most creatures killed (everyone who hit it gets the kill)

berserker.title: Berserker
berserker.rule: Most damage dealt to creatures (health removed, overkill not counted)

butcher.title: Butcher
butcher.rule: Most boars, deer, necks, hares, lox and chickens killed

robinhood.title: Robin Hood
robinhood.rule: Most kills with a bow or crossbow in hand

punchbag.title: Punching bag
punchbag.rule: Most damage taken, from any source

prospector.title: Prospector
prospector.rule: Most rocks and ore deposits mined out

forager.title: Forager
forager.rule: Most berries, mushrooms, flowers and crops picked up

blitz.title: Blitz
blitz.rule: Most new zones discovered within one hour

edgelord.title: Edge lord
edgelord.rule: Discovered the zone farthest from spawn

homebody.title: Homebody
homebody.rule: Closest to spawn on average among the zones they discovered (≥10 zones, ≥2 h played)

dungeon.title: Dungeon crawler
dungeon.rule: Most zones with a crypt, cave or other dungeon discovered

contact.title: First contact
contact.rule: Online when a trader’s camp (Haldor, Hildir, the Bog Witch) was first found

speedbuild.title: Speed builder
speedbuild.rule: Most pieces added between two hourly world saves

wreck.title: Wrecking ball
wreck.rule: Most pieces torn down between two hourly world saves

passenger.title: Passenger
passenger.rule: Pulls the least weight: share of exploration and building ÷ share of playtime (1.0 = fair share; ≥2 h played)

hoard.title: Dragon’s hoard
hoard.rule: Most loot taken from dungeon, treasure and shipwreck chests

stinky.title: Mr Stinky
stinky.rule: Most entrails, guck, ooze and bloodbags picked up

tetris.title: Chest Tetris
tetris.rule: Fewest items per chest (≥3 chests built, current world)

decorator.title: Interior decorator
decorator.rule: Highest share of furniture & decoration among their pieces (≥30 pieces, current world)

woodage.title: Still in the Wood Age
woodage.rule: Highest share of wood among their walls, floors, beams and roofs — though the Elder is long dead (≥50 pieces, current world)

pyro.title: Pyromaniac
pyro.rule: Most fires, torches and braziers built (current world)

overachiever.title: Overachiever
overachiever.rule: Most crafted gear of quality ★3 or higher in chests (current world)

taxidermist.title: Taxidermist
taxidermist.rule: Most items on their item & armor stands (current world)

gordon.title: Gordon Ramsay
gordon.rule: Most burnt or forgotten food on cooking stations they built (current world)

lastbreath.title: Last breath
lastbreath.rule: Lowest health they lived through (a close call: below 10 %, back above half)

closecalls.title: Living dangerously
closecalls.rule: Most close calls — below 10 % health, survived

globetrotter.title: Globetrotter
globetrotter.rule: Longest way travelled — on foot, swimming, sailing and riding

deaths.why: dies all the time and keeps coming back

survival.why: ancient, calm and very hard to kill

hoard.why: sleeps on a pile of treasure

wreck.why: leaves a mess wherever they go

construction.name: Construction
construction.bad: has yet to discover the hammer

exploration.name: Exploration
exploration.good: knows every corner of the map

punctuality.name: Punctuality
punctuality.bad: keeps everyone guessing when they’ll show up
